title: English Prepositions of Time
definition: Prepositions of time indicate when an action happens, including specific times, days, dates, and longer periods.

rules.rule: Used for specific clock times, mealtimes, holidays, and exact points in time (at 5 PM, at noon, at Christmas).
Used for days of the week, specific dates, and special single days (on Monday, on July 4th, on my birthday).
Used for months, years, centuries, seasons, and periods of time (in May, in 2026, in summer, in the morning).

examples.sentence: We have a meeting on Tuesday.
examples.translation: We have a meeting on Tuesday.
